mapper.insert:
SELECT member_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO member ( mno, mtype, memail, mpasswd, mname, mgender, mbirth, mtel, mzipcode, maddr, maddrdetail, mauth, mstatus, mcreate ) VALUES ( #{mno}, #{mtype}, #{memail}, #{mpasswd}, #{mname}, #{mgender}, #{mbirth}, #{mtel}, #{mzipcode}, #{maddr}, #{maddrdetail}, #{mauth}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT mno, mtype, memail, mname, mgender, mbirth, mtel, mzipcode, maddr, maddrdetail, mauth, mstatus, mcreate, mupdate FROM member WHERE mno = #{mno}
SELECT mno, memail, mpasswd, mname, mgender, mbirth, mtel, mzipcode, maddr, maddrdetail, mauth, mstatus, mtype FROM member WHERE memail = #{memail}

SELECT mno, memail, mname, mgender, mbirth, mtel, mzipcode, maddr, maddrdetail, mtype, mstatus, mauth, mprovider, mprovider_id FROM member WHERE mprovider = #{provider} AND mprovider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( mno, memail, mpasswd, mname, mgender, mbirth, mtel, mzipcode, maddr, maddrdetail, mtype, mstatus, mcreate, mauth, mprovider, mprovider_id ) VALUES ( member_seq.NEXTVAL, #{memail}, #{mpasswd}, #{mname}, 'NONE', TO_DATE('1900-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD'), '000-0000-0000', '00000', '소셜로그인', '소셜로그인', 'PERSONAL', 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE, 'ROLE_USER', #{mprovider}, #{mproviderId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET mname = #{mname}, mtel = #{mtel}, mzipcode = #{mzipcode}, maddr = #{maddr}, maddrdetail = #{maddrdetail}, mupdate = SYSDATE WHERE mno = #{mno}
